methodology.graph: Existing table-symbol-based AST columns collector: resolved Drizzle insert/update/upsert/static INSERT writers, opaque writer refusals, semantic table-column references, and checker row-shape reads.
methodology.provenance: Writer value expressions traced through object properties and local definitions; classifications are evidence labels, not automatic trust verdicts.
methodology.exclusions: Schema declarations and tests are excluded from production consumption. Migrations are historical DDL, not current product producers.

confirmedFindings.scenario: Any resumable SSE delta is expected to append to chat_stream_events, but production contains only readers. A reconnect or clamp reads an empty ledger, so resume semantics cannot be implemented by the declared table.
confirmedFindings.proposedControl: Build one append producer that mints ChatStreamEventId and derives chatId/messageId from the same server-trusted message root. Add a negative cross-chat mismatch test and a planted graph control proving the writer disappears when removed.

confirmedFindings.scenario: Create a valid character whose handle is exactly 200 UTF-16 units, then duplicate it. freeCopyHandle appends -copy and castId brands the 205-unit string; insertCharacter writes it because Drizzle $type is compile-time only and the schema has no length CHECK. A handoff collision similarly appends -2 to an already-maximal source handle.
confirmedFindings.proposedControl: Centralize a length-preserving derived CharacterHandle constructor that reserves suffix width and validates before branding. Route duplicate and handoff collision generation through it; add max-length and non-BMP negative controls that prove every persisted handle still satisfies the canonical schema.

limitations: This is a source graph over the current native TypeScript programs, not runtime database contents or migration history.
Drizzle $type is type-only. A typed parameter/property is a propagation rung until its constructor, parser, registry lookup, FK source, or sentinel is inspected.
The graph does not prove validation for dynamic code, reflection, generated code outside loaded programs, or raw SQL whose table/column header cannot be statically resolved.
The conservative reader candidate set is deliberately over-inclusive; use table-symbol reads as the precise subset and row-shape reads as discovery leads.
The shared worktree contained concurrent edits. This read-only task changed no repository file and the report records HEAD plus current-tree analysis rather than claiming a clean checkout.
